I'm trying to reconcile the timeline: the original request was for readings every three months with the next one due mid-June, but the landlord's latest message says the next time it's needed is September 15th — I need to figure out which date actually takes precedence given these conflicting statements.

I'll schedule the September 15th date as the next confirmed reading, flag the discrepancy with the mid-June mention, and note the unclear provenance of the photo attached to the landlord's message since the tenant's email thread didn't include a visible attachment. In my reply to the landlord I should also ask directly whether September 15th replaces the mid-June date and whether the quarterly cadence continues from there, while briefly letting the tenant know a reading will be requested around that date.

Then repeat every 3 months (original instruction) unless the landlord says otherwise. Mid-June date in the original request is unconfirmed against this.

arguments.body: Hello Ava, thank you. We have noted that you next need the solar panel reading on 15 September, and we will ask the tenant for the photo ahead of that date. Should we still collect them every 3 months after 15 September, and do you still want the mid June one? Please reply by 24 January so we keep the schedule right. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings

Hello Miles, thank you for getting back to us. We have the reading we need for now, so nothing more is needed at the moment. The landlord will next need a photo of the solar panel meter display around 15 September, so we will email you a few days before to ask. Kind regards, Northbridge Lettings

Follow-up scheduled 15 Sept, recurring 3-monthly pending landlord answer.
